# Chirograph

> Typed HTTP clients generated from OpenAPI documents at build time.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://rocketsurgeonsguild.github.io/Chirograph/pr-preview/pr-22/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Chirograph, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://rocketsurgeonsguild.github.io/Chirograph/pr-preview/pr-22/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Chirograph

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
